industry_returns.source_frequency: monthly; source also contains other frequency blocks
industry_returns.processed_unit: decimal simple portfolio return per month
industry_returns.return_variant: standard 10 Industry Portfolios dataset; not the separately published ex. Dividends variant
transformations: The monthly value-weighted table was parsed from the frozen source CSV.
Percent values were divided by 100 exactly once.
Source missing sentinels -99.99 and -999 became empty fields in the processed CSV.
industry_returns.redistribution: Public download availability is not a blanket redistribution license. Attribute Fama and French and check current terms before external redistribution.

monthly_risk_free.source_frequency: monthly rows; source values are published as percent per month
transformations: The first YYYYMM monthly block was selected; later annual blocks were excluded.
Source percent values were divided by 100 exactly once.
Source missing sentinels -99.99 and -999 became empty fields.
monthly_risk_free.methodology_change: The source states that the one-month Treasury-bill series uses Ibbotson Associates through May 2024 and ICE BofA US 1-Month Treasury Bill Index from June 2024.
monthly_risk_free.redistribution: Public download availability is not a blanket redistribution license. Attribute Fama and French and check current terms before external redistribution.

run_validation.join_rule: exactly identical monthly PeriodIndex; one-to-one month join
run_validation.missing_rule: no fill or row drop; loader rejects non-finite selected values and monthly gaps

time_scope.month_label: period label for a published monthly return interval; not an intramonth timestamp
time_scope.available_at: historical per-month publication/ingestion times are not supplied; only the current snapshot download times above are known
time_scope.signal_time: not applicable; no signal is formed
time_scope.trade_time: not applicable; no order or trade is simulated
time_scope.label_interval: same calendar month; there is no forecast target in this descriptive project
